title: account-tests answer
description: One row per test file the deleted-tests check refused at ship: the test that now pins its behaviour, or why the behaviour is gone. The driver appends the rows to the run's record, rebuilds the pull request's '## Deleted tests' section from it and runs the check again; a file still without a row parks the ticket.

skills.description: Every skill invoked in this step: none, so always empty. The driver cross-checks it against the Skill calls in the run log.

replacedTests.description: One row per listed file, by the repo-relative path the check names. Exactly one of `coveredBy` — a bare repo-relative path to a test file at head with a live case that now pins the same behaviour — or `removedBecause`, one line on why the behaviour is gone.
